description: Relief Wells is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. National Levee Database This feature layer, utilizing National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA) data from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), displays levees within the United States. Per USACE, “The National Levee Database captures all known levees in the United States. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are NGDA, National Geospatial Data Asset, FGDC, Federal Geospatial Data Committee, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, USACE, federal, levee. The bounding box given is -124.0760,26.6266,-71.8336,48.5607. The hub shows 2026-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
